schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Group all non-major devDependency updates into a single PR to reduce review churn.

Auto-merge is DISABLED deliberately. Correction of record: an earlier version of this comment said the default branch had no protection. That was wrong — it is protected by the 'Sprint 1F active line protection' ruleset, which the classic branch-protection API does not report, which is how both the author and the reviewer missed it. The ruleset requires two status checks but the approving-review count is 0 while the repository has a single collaborator, so an auto-merged dependency PR would reach this public repository's default branch with no human in the loop. That is the reason this stays off, and it is a stronger reason than the one it replaces. Re-enable once a second reviewer exists and the review requirement is raised back to 1.
Group GitHub Actions digest updates; the repository pins every action by SHA.

Keep the Trigger.dev SDK, build package, and CLI on the same version, together with the realtime-transport and extraction packages the overrides block forces on their behalf. Mismatched versions across the three break the worker build, and a transport bump landing separately from its parent is how a forced resolution outlives its reason.

Keep Next.js, its ESLint config, and the two transitives the overrides block forces on Next's behalf (postcss, sharp) in one pull request. A Next major arriving without them would silently persist forced resolutions the new Next never declared.
Keep React and its types aligned.
Major upgrades are never auto-merged; they require review and an explicit decision.
Let new releases settle before proposing them, to avoid churn on immediately-patched versions.

Surface any override update distinctly. Renovate raises override floors automatically but never proposes removing an entry, so overrides accumulate by default. A labelled pull request is the prompt to check whether the entry is still needed at all -- see the removal rule in package.json's //overrides note.
